results.title: Indonesia: nine orangutans rescued from wildfires return to the forest
results.content: Nine orangutans rescued from devastating wildfires in Indonesian Borneo have returned to the forest after weeks of rehabilitation. Among them are four mothers with their young, including three females expecting another baby.

results.title: King Charles’ visit to Guyana reignites calls for a British apology and reparations for slavery
results.content: King Charles the Third’s visit to Guyana is bringing renewed attention to Britain’s colonial past and growing calls for an apology over slavery.

results.title: US: flowers laid at Patrick Stewart's Hollywood star after his death
results.content: Flowers have been placed at Patrick Stewart's Hollywood Walk of Fame star following reports of the British actor's death at 86. Visitors gather in Los Angeles to remember his celebrated screen roles.

results.title: French publisher returns to Algiers book fair after two-year ban
results.content: Gallimard has been caught in legal battles over accusations that French-Algerian writer, Kamel Daoud, plagiarised a women's life in his novel 'Houris'.

results.title: Africa Cup of Nations to maintain 2-year cycle after CAF U-turn
results.content: The Africa Cup of Nations will maintain its two-year cycle after a U-turn from the Confederation of African Football. Earlier this month, CAF announced the Africa Nations League as a new biennial competition. It said AFCON would move to a four-year cycle.

results.title: US: Trump hands out sweets as Air Force One soars overhead
results.content: Donald and Melania Trump welcomed children in Halloween costumes to the White House on Thursday. The couple handed out sweets, posed for photographs and watched Air Force One fly overhead.

results.title: South Africa selects Durban as preferred candidate for Olympic bid
results.content: The SA Sports Confederation and Olympic Committee says, however, it will likely be a "multi-city" bid that would propose some events are held in other cities.

results.title: Haiti announces new election dates as El Salvador sends troops to rescue missing soldiers
results.content: Haiti’s government has announced new election dates as the armed gangs who terrorize the country continue to fight against Haitian police and soldiers, who are now backed by the recent arrival of more than 2,000 troops from El Salvador.

results.title: Durban to lead South Africa’s bid to bring Olympics to Africa
results.content: South Africa has selected Durban to lead its bid for the 2036 or 2040 Summer Olympics, as the country seeks to become the first in Africa to host the Games.

results.title: Mexico: world's tallest Catrina unveiled for Día de Muertos in Mexico City
results.content: A 33.4-metre Catrina has broken a Guinness World Record in Mexico City. Towering over the Zócalo, the giant skeleton is surrounded by thousands of marigolds ahead of Day of the Dead celebrations.

results.title: Israel's final election results show no bloc has won a majority
results.content: As opposition politicians meet to explore options for a coalition, the PM has accused Arab-led parties of election fraud.

results.title: DR Congo: MSF celebrates Ebola patient discharges in Ituri province
results.content: Dancing and singing erupted at an Ebola treatment centre in DR Congo as the last patients were discharged. For the first time since May, the MSF-run facility has no confirmed cases under treatment, although the wider outbreak continues.

results.title: CAR tightens border checks as DR Congo's Ebola cases rise
results.content: With the virus in three Congolese regions bordering the country, the authorities have also launched awareness campaigns.

results.title: Ukraine: Russian strike kills two teenage girls in Chernihiv
results.content: A Russian strike on Chernihiv killed two 15-year-old girls and injured 25 people, local officials say. Meanwhile, a US-brokered ceasefire in southern Ukraine is allowing demining work aimed at opening humanitarian routes.

results.title: Spain: minute of silence for train crash victims as king visits hospital
results.content: Spain is mourning 69 people killed in a high-speed train collision near Toledo. As King Felipe VI visits a hospital treating the injured, rescuers continue searching the wreckage and a minute of silence is held at the crash site.

results.title: Cameroon families demand return of relatives from Ukraine
results.content: In Cameroon, the “Bring Back Our Sons and Brothers” collective organised a peaceful march on Wednesday, 28 October, to the Russian embassy. They are calling on Russia and the Cameroonian government to work together to dismantle networks recruiting Cameroonians clandestinely into the Russian army.

results.title: Libya’s central bank targeted in overnight raid raising fresh concerns
results.content: Libya's central bank on Thursday said unidentified individuals raided its headquarters in Tripoli, hours after parliament said it had accepted a request from its governor to resign.

results.title: No clear majority emerges as Israel counts final election votes
results.content: The Israeli Elections Committee continued counting votes on Thursday from envelopes cast by voters authorized to vote outside their assigned polling stations.

results.title: Cubans call for lifting of embargo, express hope for better lives
results.content: Cuban citizens expressed hope that the US will respond to the calls of the international community as soon as possible and voiced their wishes for better lives, after the United Nations General Assembly adopted a resolution for the 34th consecutive time urging the US to end its embargo.

results.title: DRC: US sanctions on Rwanda draw mixed reactions in Goma
results.content: In Goma, some residents want to believe that this additional pressure could help break the deadlock. Michel Kamango hopes the sanctions will affect the parties concerned and help bring about a return to peace.

results.title: Putin hails 'natural allies' at Russia-Africa summit in Moscow
results.content: President Putin welcomed nearly two dozen African leaders to the Kremlin on Wednesday for a two-day Russia-Africa summit.

results.title: Vatican: Century of Mercedes-Benz popemobiles goes on display
results.content: From silk-lined limousines to vehicles fitted with bulletproof glass, eight historic popemobiles go on display at the Vatican Museums. The exhibition traces how papal transport has evolved over nearly a century.

results.title: French music producer awaits trial six years after police beating
results.content: Six years after being violently beaten by three police officers, Michel Zecler is awaiting the opening of their trial on 9 November in Paris. The music producer says he remains deeply scarred and angry over police violence.

results.title: Gabon oil rig disaster: Three bodies found, two still missing
results.content: Three bodies have been found following the sinking of an oil rig off the coast of Gabon on Saturday, while the search continues for two people still missing, according to an updated toll released by Gabonese authorities overnight from Wednesday to Thursday.

results.title: DRC Ebola clinic celebrates departure of last confirmed cases
results.content: Medical staff were joined by local residents as they celebrated the departure of the last Ebola patients from a treatment center in DR Congo’s Ituri province. It’s the first time the Médicins Sans Frontières-run clinic has had no confirmed Ebola cases since the outbreak was declared in May.

results.title: A year after Tanzania’s bloody election, victims still await justice
results.content: A year after Tanzania's bloody election, many remain traumatised by the violence, while government critics live in fear of abduction and arbitrary arrest, or facing treason and terrorism charges.

results.title: Albania: opposition MPs disrupt parliament with smoke flares
results.content: Opposition MPs disrupted a parliamentary session in Albania by brandishing smoke flares and displaying photographs of injured protesters. They accused police of using violence against demonstrators demanding Prime Minister Edi Rama's resignation.

results.title: Rembrandt's masterpieces become tattoos in the Netherlands
results.content: Visitors to the Rembrandt House Museum in Amsterdam, the Netherlands, can once again take home a piece of the Dutch master's art, permanently tattooed on their skin.

results.title: Cameroonian opposition parties condemn the suspension of Issa Tchiroma’s party
results.content: Cameroonian opposition parties condemned the three-month suspension of Issa Tchiroma Bakary’s political party, the National Salvation Front of Cameroon.
